hints.title: Exact Subset Sum Formulation
hints.text: For each index, selecting queries that overlap with it allows subtracting exact query values. The array becomes all zeros precisely when each element can be represented as an exact subset sum of its overlapping query values.

hints.title: Sequential Bitmask Representation
hints.text: Maintain a bitset or bitmask for each index representing the subset sums formed by the queries seen so far.

hints.title: Bitwise Left Shift Updates
hints.text: For each query with range [l, r] and value, shift the bitmask of each index in that range by value and perform bitwise OR with itself. Check if every target value bit is set.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise shift operations evaluate reachable sums in parallel for each query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive subset sum evaluation per index takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmasks store subset sums efficiently in linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the knapsack subset sum equivalence and optimize it using bitwise shifts.
